description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'SupervisorEvaluationSearchFilterParams' used for filtering supervisor evaluation search results within the OrangeHRM Performance module. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties for review ID and self-evaluation status, along with their accessor methods.

classes.name: SupervisorEvaluationSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class encapsulating filtering parameters for supervisor evaluation searches, including review ID and self-evaluation indicator.

methods.name: getReviewId
methods.description: Returns the review ID used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setReviewId
methods.description: Sets the review ID filter criterion.
